evidence: Inspected the chloride-aware nitrite path in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/events.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs`, and `crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs`: `chloride_protection_factor` is a named shrimp parameter, the effective hazard formula matches the bead spec, nitrite stress still flows through `hourly_nitrite_stress_accum`, and trace/event output exposes nitrite, chloride, effective hazard, and stress increment.

Acceptance-criteria coverage is present in tests: unit coverage in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, scenario coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_chloride_protection.rs`, event coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/events.rs`, and trace coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/tracing.rs`.

Reviewed the follow-on denitrification fixes in `crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_tracking.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/denitrification.rs`, and `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs`: N2 export is now part of the nitrogen ledger, invariant guards cover the new denitrification state/params, and the denitrification export conservation assertion matches the tracked-budget behavior.

`cargo test -p tank_core --test denitrification --test budget_tracking --test shrimp_chloride_protection --test tracing --test events --test validation --test save_load` passed with 122 tests passed and 0 failed.
Workspace-level `cargo test` surfaced no new failures in the reviewed area; the only failing test remains the previously known unrelated `crates/tank_core/tests/thermal_reproduction_penalty.rs` case.
findings_or_gaps: No new correctness, regression, or completeness issues found in the scoped change set.
